title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The final decay rate must be correctly calculated as 1.19 x 10^7 s^-1.

title: Energy Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The maximum energy of the decay neutrino must be correctly determined for both decay processes.

title: Proportionality Setup
description: Important Criteria: The relationship between the decay rates of the two processes must be correctly established using the ratio of energies.

title: Matrix Element Consistency
description: Important Criteria: The assumption that the matrix elements for both decays are the same must be clearly stated.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All units must be consistent throughout the calculations, particularly in energy and decay rates.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes or incorrect energy values that could lead to an incorrect final answer.

title: Lifetime Reference
description: Optional Criteria: The lifetime of the neutron should be correctly referenced as approximately 10^3 seconds.

title: Final Expression Clarity
description: Optional Criteria: The final expression for the decay rate should be clearly presented and easy to follow.
